}}'''Feraighin''' is an [[Aiel]] [[Wise One]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Feraighin|Feraighin}}

== Appearance ==
She is "youngish", long-nosed with a large amount of red hair and brilliant blue eyes. She is capable of channeling, but is not strong. Her exact strength in the power is unknown. She speaks in a hurried manner.{{ref||Feraighin}}

== Activities ==
She greets [[Rand al'Thor]] and his army when they arrive back in [[Cairhien]] after the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]].{{ref/book|7|3}} She reports all that has happened after Rand is kidnapped by [[Aes Sedai]] such as the bleakness hitting the Aiel again and [[Colavaere Saighan]] taking the [[Sun Throne]] for herself. She names [[Perrin]] ''[[sei'cair]]'', the [[Old Tongue]] for Golden Eyes.
